title: Jabba the Hutt
franchise: Star Wars: Return of the Jedi
description: The vile gangster Jabba the Hutt was one of the most powerful cartel leaders in the galaxy, ruling from his palace throne on Tatooine. His influence had a long reach, both in galactic politics and in the galactic underworld. Han Solo learned the length of Jabba's reach the hard way, finding himself frozen in carbonite, a decoration on Jabba's wall, as punishment for not paying his debts.
